name: TableCraft
summary: Drizzle ORM table engine plus a React data table component on TanStack Table and shadcn/ui; columns come from your schema.
description: A backend query engine and React table component that generate table columns automatically from a Drizzle schema, with no column definitions. Server-side filtering, sorting, global search, cursor or offset pagination, CSV/Excel export, column resizing, URL state sync and role-based column visibility, with adapters for Hono, Express, Next.js, SvelteKit and Elysia.
contains: columns auto-generated from the Drizzle schema, no column definitions
server-side filtering, sorting, search and pagination
CSV and Excel export of selected or all rows
search, filters, sort and page state synced to the URL
server adapters: Hono, Express, Next.js, SvelteKit, Elysia
packages: engine, table, codegen, client, plugin-cache
